facts.fact: The National Treasury allocated Sh12.7 billion to the digital superhighway programme in the FY2025/26 budget estimates presented by Treasury CS John Mbadi.
The FY2025/26 allocation of Sh12.7 billion for the digital superhighway programme is a 22 per cent reduction from Sh16.3 billion in FY2024/25.
The FY2025/26 budget allocates Sh3.1 billion to the Konza Data Centre and Smart City project, down from Sh5.2 billion in FY2024/25.
facts.system: Konza Data Centre and Smart City project, FY2025/26 budget

facts.fact: The FY2025/26 budget raises funding for the Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration project to Sh3.7 billion from Sh2.8 billion in FY2024/25; the document does not say how the project is financed.
facts.system: Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration project, FY2025/26 budget

note: Facts are budget-day reporting of proposed estimates; no commitment statement beyond a general assurance of targeted investments and public-private partnerships.
